detached_structure.evidence: A small square structure with a roof sits on the patio area just east of the main house, possibly a gazebo or shed. A dark structure also appears in the wooded area to the north, but it is mostly hidden by canopy.
detached_structure.detail: possible gazebo or small shed on patio

signals.notes: The house is heavily surrounded by mature trees with a semicircular patio and small open grass clearing to the northeast; the roof is partly shaded and the lot borders dense woods, so condition and any hidden features are hard to confirm.
